what: Arch Capital is a Bermuda-based insurer and reinsurer. It writes specialty insurance for businesses, reinsurance for other insurers, and mortgage insurance that protects lenders against homeowner default.
customers: Businesses buying specialty cover, insurance companies buying reinsurance, and mortgage lenders.
moat: The discipline to shrink when prices are bad and grow sharply when they are good, which few insurers manage, built on a management team with a long record.
risks: Reinsurance pricing has softened after several very strong years
Catastrophe losses can be large in any single year
Mortgage insurance losses would rise if US house prices fell
opportunities: Revenue grew about 14% last year and about 28% a year over three years
Mortgage insurance has run at exceptionally low loss rates
A 22% net margin with a record of growing book value per share
watch: The combined ratio and the pricing cycle in reinsurance.
